review_candidates.title: Systems Engineer - Honolulu
review_candidates.description: We are hiring a Systems Engineer in Honolulu. This is project and escalation work. You will run migrations, take the tickets that get handed up from the service desk, build and clean up client environments, and have real input into what a client should do next. You will also be one of the people our Systems Administrators learn from. Most people who do well here spent a few years on a service desk first and are ready for work with more depth to it. If you find yourself more interested in why something broke than in how fast you closed it, that is the right instinct for this seat. About Levels We hire engineers at more than one level. If you are earlier in your career than this description, or well past it, apply anyway. We will have an honest conversation about where you actually fit and place you there. This job is on-island You need to live in Hawaii and be able to get to client sites. This is not a remote position, but it is hybrid. Work from home is on the table. Our clients are here and their equipment is here. We have been earning their trust in person. Our engineers also spend a lot of time teaching our Systems Administrators, and that goes better in the same room. Why work at Intech? We Have Been Doing This In Hawaii For Over 30 Years. Managed IT. Cybersecurity. Compliance. Five Core Values Guide The Company People First (people matter to us, both in our office and in our clients' offices) Accountability (we take ownership and responsibility for our work) Teamwork (no one can have a good day if anyone is having a bad day) Humor (we're funny... or at least we think we are) Growth (if we're not growing, we're falling behind) Where the work is headed A couple of things worth knowing before you apply. We are putting real effort into automation, which means our engineers spend less time repeating the same work and more time on problems that are actually interesting. Our compliance practice is also growing. We build and manage secure enclaves for clients who have to meet CMMC and NIST 800-171 requirements. If either of those is where you want your career to go, tell us in your application. Requirements What do I need to bring to the table? Be a good person first. The engineers here are good teachers, with clients and with the techs around them. They take a project from quote through deployment and own it. They will methodically work a problem for as long as it takes, and they ask for help when they are stuck. Be curious. You do not need to spend your weekends in a home lab. You do need to go find out how something works instead of waiting for someone to explain it. Write things down. We care a lot about ticket notes and documentation. If you have ever written up an ugly problem so the next tech would not have to suffer through it, you will fit in here. Other Requirements You must live in Hawaii. A valid driver's license and a car are required for planned and unplanned onsite visits. The technical side This is the working knowledge we use day to day: Core networking: DNS, DHCP, routing, subnetting, VLANs Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DFS, and domain controller migrations Microsoft 365 administration, migrations, and tenant management Entra ID: identity, conditional access, MFA rollouts Azure infrastructure and architecture Virtualization: Hyper-V and VMware Endpoint management and security baselines (Intune, EDR) Email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and multi-factor providers (Entra MFA, Duo) SAN and NAS high-availability technologies Remote Desktop Services: RD Gateway, session hosts PowerShell scripting and automation inside MSP tooling Server hardware quoting and troubleshooting (we are a Dell shop) Documentation: network diagrams, runbooks, configuration records Nobody has all of it. If you are strong in most of it, apply. Certifications Microsoft certifications carry the most weight here. The three we care about most are MD-102 for endpoint and Intune, SC-300 for identity and conditional access, and AZ-104 for Azure infrastructure. AZ-305 comes later, once AZ-104 is behind you and you are scoping migrations instead of running them. Network+ and Security+ are nice to have. None of them are required to apply and we do not screen on them. We pay for training and testing, and certification pay is added on top of your base salary. If you are strong everywhere else and short a cert, apply anyway. Benefits What is in it for me? Salary is based on your experience and where we place you. Certification pay of up to $10,000 per year sits on top of base, paid quarterly. Medical, drug, dental, and vision coverage 401K Paid vacation Twelve paid holidays per year Quarterly performance reviews Quarterly company outings Monthly cell phone allowance Paid parking downtown Paid training and certification incentives, plus a defined career ladder above this role

Rattaché au Responsable IT, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l’administration, la sécurisation et l’évolution de l’infrastructure informatique. Véritable référent technique sur les environnements systèmes et réseaux, vous serez également le bras droit du Responsable IT sur les sujets techniques du quotidien et participerez activement aux projets de transformation de l’infrastructure. Vos responsabilités · Assurer l’administration, la maintenance et l’évolution de l’infrastructure systèmes et réseaux. · Être le bras droit technique du Responsable IT dans la gestion des activités du service. · Assurer le support de niveau 2 (L2) et prendre en charge les incidents nécessitant une expertise technique avancée. · Administrer et maintenir les environnements VMware et les infrastructures de virtualisation. · Participer à l’évolution de l’architecture réseau. · Administrer et maintenir les firewalls Palo Alto et Fortinet, ainsi que les équipements réseau. · Administrer les environnements Windows Server et leurs principaux services (Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, GPO, etc.). · Administrer les serveurs Linux et assurer leur maintien en conditions opérationnelles. · Reprendre, maintenir et faire évoluer les scripts PowerShell existants afin d’automatiser certaines tâches d’administration. · Assurer l’administration et l’exploitation de l’environnement Microsoft 365. · Participer activement aux projets d’hybridation et de modernisation de l’infrastructure IT, notamment sur les aspects systèmes, réseaux et services cloud. · Contribuer à la sécurisation, à la supervision et à l’amélioration continue de l’infrastructure. Compétences techniques indispensables · Virtualisation : administration et gestion d’environnements VMware. · Réseaux : très bonnes connaissances des architectures et protocoles réseau, ainsi que de l’administration des équipements réseau. · Windows Server : très bonnes connaissances de l’administration des serveurs Windows et de leurs principaux services. · PowerShell : autonomie dans la lecture, la compréhension, la reprise et l’évolution de scripts existants. · Switching & Firewalling : expérience pratique dans l’administration et le dépannage des switches et firewalls. · Linux : bonnes connaissances de l’administration de serveurs Linux. · Microsoft 365 : connaissances approfondies de l’administration et de la gestion de l’environnement Microsoft 365. Votre profil · Diplôme de niveau Bac+3 en informatique ou formation équivalente. · Minimum 3 ans d’expérience dans une fonction similaire en administration systèmes et réseaux. · Solide capacité d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes techniques. · Esprit autonome, pragmatique et orienté solutions. · Capacité à travailler sur des environnements techniques variés et à prendre en charge des sujets de bout en bout. · Bon sens du service et aisance dans le support aux utilisateurs. · Capacité à collaborer avec les différents interlocuteurs IT et métiers. · Sens des priorités et aptitude à intervenir dans un environnement où la disponibilité et la sécurité des systèmes sont essentielles.
